concept: A confident focus workshop where plans, tools, and neatly organized supplies make the next useful step feel inviting.
main_structure: One compact open-front workshop at the rear with a broad curved navy roof, warm timber walls, one large arched doorway, and two oversized amber windows.
rear_props: one broad planning bench with a single large blank plan sheet
one large blank task board beside a chunky tool cabinet
side_props: one large toolbox, two rolled plans, and one broad focus lantern on the upper-left edge
two stacked storage crates, one oversized pencil-cup shape, and one broad focus lantern on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous smooth blue-green workshop border with broad rounded capstones
perimeter.emblems: four oversized simple gold leaf-shaped focus emblems

lighting: soft clear daylight with warm workshop windows and two broad amber focus lanterns
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open grass
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature or egg baked into the bitmap
center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, paving, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, readable writing, numbers, watermark, external shadow
tiny tools, paper clutter, checkmark clutter, flowers, grass blades, pebbles, cracks, specks, or dense texture
